violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Two buckets of sanitation water were voluntarily put together at the start of the inspection without the inspectors request. Both buckets tested over 200ppm Chlorine. The proper concentration amount was discussed with the employee on staff.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -The microwave is in need of a deep cleaning. -There is a build up of crumbs and food particles in the stand-up freezer floor. This is located in the room next to the bar area.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. -ToGo boxes and boxes of plastic cups were found stored on the floor of the dry storage area.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. -The ceiling above the first walk in cooler (room with the ice machine and furnace) is falling down. -Two large holes are between the urinal and sink of the men's bathroom connected to the event hall/Dining Room.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. -The mop was found stored in the mop bucket unable to air dry.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -Food items post-portioning stored in a box on the floor of the walk-in freezer.

Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Food contact surface of clean in place equipment was not cleaned properly. -Refrigerator and pizza ovens have food product build up. In need of cleaning

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Dry storage area with soda boxes in need of sweeping. -Area behind cooking equipment in need of cleaning. -Walls behind cooking equipment in need of cleaning
